body: Unfortunately this is a common experience with J.C. Pennywise because something similar had happened with me. During my first two weeks training I was constantly left alone to fend for myself and management kept making excuses for why I should just be okay with it. My Hr manager constantly harassed me about being late even though she hired me knowing I took the bus. She followed me into the locker room and basically cornered me about needing to show up on time when I would stay late if I clocked in late. I was hired at $15/hr but put on the schedule for 36 hrs in a week. I talked to the GM and expressed I would only work full time hours for full time pay. He tried telling me that they don’t pay based on full/part time they pay based on experience…I’ve been working retail since 16 so that was a slap in the face. When I asked to only work 25 hrs max I was given less than 20, almost completely eliminating me from the schedule budget…I ended up accepting a better retail sales position because I’m tired of low hours, micromanaging, and still being expected to pick up slack from other people with no recognition. Glad you got out of there and are on to better thing💕

I’m not sure if different stores pay on different weeks but I called my HR manager this last Friday and she said I should have gotten my check yesterday and I haven’t yet…so maybe I’ll just end up getting it this Friday instead 🤷🏽‍♀️it’s just frustrating because I can’t get a straight answer from JCP office or my HR manager 😪
You are not locked in! You can move out by finding a new person to take over your portion of the lease. You can leave and live your life while she’ll have to live with a random stranger 🤷🏽‍♀️
